programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Partizani, film
programme.desc: U II Svjetskom ratu, mlada Židovka, tražeći svoju rodbinu, prepoznaje u komandantu židovskog transporta druga iz djetinjstva, Austrijanca. Prilikom napada partizana na transport, Austrijanac je ranjen i, samo se zahvaljujući djevojčinoj pomoći, uspijeva spasiti. Djevojčino zauzimanje za njega izaziva nepoverenje partizanskog komandanta prema njoj. U dramatičnim okolnostima, Austrijanac uzalud pokušava da pronađe Židovku, dok se ona sve više vezuje za partizanskog komandanta. Između njih dvoje rađa se ljubav, a Austrijanac, ogorčen što ju je izgubio, postaje vođa najžešćih kaznenih ekspedicija.

programme.title: Pejzaži u magli, film
programme.desc: Život i sudbina grupe mladih narkomana iz Beograda kojoj se pridruži maloletna učenica. Posle sukoba sa roditeljima i incidenta u školi, ona raskida ljubavnu vezu sa svojim mladićem i počinje da živi sa narkomanom i prodavcem droge. Sa njim i ostalim narkomanima doživljava niz dramatičnih situacija, čak dospeva i u zatvor. Pokušava da se oslobodi droge, ali ne uspeva. Posle zatvora odbija da se vrati roditeljima i sa svojom prijateljicom, bivšom narkomankom, dogovori se da odu iz Beograda. Na žalost, umesto da otputuje, njen leš pronalaze deratizatori u jednom podrumu.

programme.title: SCENA M
programme.desc: Emisija na potpuno nov način predstavlja detalje iz života poznatih ličnosti. Ovo je celebrity emisija kojoj će ljudi verovati. Sve poznate ličnosti imaju isti tretman, a mi ćemo se truditi da u Info Sceni emitujemo isključivo stvari koje su istinite i bez trunke pristrasnosti. Zašticenih ličnosti neće biti. Bićemo žestoki koliko to situacija dozvoljava. Vidimo se u Sceni!

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. programme.title: Paparazzo lov
programme.desc: U sredu 15. oktobra počinje nova, 17. po redu sezona emisije "Paparazzo lov". Novinari - istraživači prate živote poznatih ličnosti i ove godine i otkrivaju sve njihove skrivene tajne. Tako ćete već u prvoj epizodi videti nekoliko ekskluzivnih priča dugo čuvanih od javnosti. Biće tu i retrospektiva snimaka nastalih tokom leta na crnogorskom, hrvatskom i grčkom primorju. A otrkićemo i nepoznate detalje o aktuelnim učesnicima rijalitija Elita. Voditeljka ove sezone biće Katarina Nikolić. A emisija ide pod sloganom - gledajte samo na Pinku sredom u 23 časa. Nema reprize niti će epizode biti okačene na platformama.

Wild italy Serie 8 - Il riscatto della palude
programme.desc: Italija je posebna zemlja usred Sredozemlja gdje, bez obzira na brojno stanovništvo i dugu povijest civilizacije, glavni europski grabežljivci i dalje žive posve slobodno. Među njima su smeđi medvjedi, vukovi, risovi, orlovi, i svi oni iskorištavaju bogata staništa prepuna ostataka daleke prošlosti. To je prava škrinja s blagom koja od Alpa do otoka ispred Afrike skriva bogatstvo bioraznolikosti od neprocjenjive vrijednosti, tisuće vrsta biljaka i životinja, uključujući i najopasnije grabežljivce ovoga kontinenta.

programme.title: Zeleni planet
programme.desc: Zakoračite u čarobni skriveni svijet pun neobičnih priča, neočekivanih junaka i neobičnog ponašanja. Predstavit će nam ga sir David Attenborough. Biljke imaju tajni život skriven od naših očiju. Sposobne su stvoriti uzajamno koristan odnos sa životinjama. Ali također mogu biti agresivne, kompetitivne i dramatične kao i sva druga živa bića na našem planetu. U okršajima sa suparničkim biljkama, životinjama i prirodnim silama bore se za svjetlo, prostor, hranjive tvari i mogućnost razmnožavanja. Predstavljajući rezultate znanstvenih istraživanja u proteklih dvadeset godina, ova spektakularna serija otkriva koliko su biljke međusobno povezane. Specijalizirane kamere omogućuju nam da vidimo mnogo više od onoga što je dostupno ljudskom oku i upoznamo se s biljkama bolje nego ikad. Posjetit ćemo različita staništa - pustinje, tropske šume, podvodni svijet, umjereni pojas i urbani okoliš. Svaka epizoda predstavlja jednu skupinu biljaka, otkriva nam s kakvim se preprekama suočavaju i kakva su dosjetljiva rješenja našle kako bi opstale. Otkrivamo nove priče, dosad nezabilježene oblike ponašanja životinja i biljaka te neočekivane junake. Ovo je planet Zemlja iz perspektive biljaka!

Verdi - La traviata, serija
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains. Several men are courting the rich courtesan Violetta, but when she meets Alfredo, she chooses to live a new life with him. She then moves from Paris to the French countryside, but unfortunately is haunted by her past: Alfredo's father does not approve of his past and convinces her to abandon his son. Alfredo is ignorant of his father's torment and, thinking that Violetta has used him, he becomes furious. In the end, he understands that Violetta has abandoned him to be free, but it is too late. Reaching an incurable illness, Violetta dies in his arms.

programme.title: Sir Neville Marriner - Mozart Concert from Lugano
programme.desc: Renowned Mozart specialist Sir Neville Marriner (1924-2016) conducts Orchestra della Svizzera italiana in this November 2005 live recording from the Palazzo di Congressi in Lugano, Switzerland. On the program, works by Mozart! Renowned Mozart specialist Sir Neville Marriner (1924-2016) conducts Orchestra della Svizzera italiana in this November 2005 live recording from the Palazzo di Congressi in Lugano, Switzerland. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Concerto for Flute, Harp and Orchestra, K.299 (1778) is one of the Austrian composer's most popular pieces, due to its cheerful, lighthearted mood. Soloists Patrick Gallois (flute) and Fabrice Pierre (harp) have worked on their joint interpretation, providing some discreet ornamentation to Mozart's effervescent solo lines. Mozart's Overture to The Magic Flute (1791) and his Symphony No. 39 in E-flat Major (1788), jewels from the composer's late period, crown this wonderful concert program recorded on the occasion of the Mozart Anniversary Year 2006.

programme.title: Patmos - A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world. Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world. The lineup includes the festival’s artistic director and pianist Roberto Prosseda, Steven Isserlis, Irène Duval, Michael Guttman and the Brussels Chamber Orchestra, and Peter Phillips and The Tallis Scholars. In interviews, several artists share their experiences of this intimate festival and the unique atmosphere of the island. The documentary was produced by the Patmos Music Festival Association and directed by Alberto Girotto.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Debussy, Chopin and Liszt
programme.desc: The first edition of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM) was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Claude Debussy’s Images, book I; Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 1; and Franz Liszt’s Paraphrase from Verdi’s ‘Rigoletto’. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in February 2020. Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Claude Debussy’s Images, book I; Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 1; and Franz Liszt’s Paraphrase from Verdi’s ‘Rigoletto’. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in February 2020.

programme.title: T. Merula - Aria Sopra La Cieccona
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020. Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. On the program are ‘Mira questi due lumi’ from Cavalli’s Le nozze di Teti e di Peleo, ‘Dimmi, Amor, che farò’ from L'Oristeo, ‘Sinfonia della notte’ from L’Egisto, and ‘E vuol dunque Ciprigna’ from Ercole Amante; ‘M’ingannasti in verità’ from Bembo’s Produzioni armoniche consacrate a Luigi XIV; Strozzi’s Sino alla morte, Che si può fare, Lagrime mie, L’amante segreto, and è Pazzo il moi core; Biagio Marini’s La Romanesca; Tarquinio Merula’s Aria Sopra La Cieccona; and Dario Castello’s Sonata Seconda. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Nikolai Kapustin - Sinfonietta op. 49 - Overture
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition: II. Gnomus
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform the Violin Concerto, Op. 61 by Ludwig van Beethoven, under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform the Violin Concerto, Op. 61 by Ludwig van Beethoven under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. Beethoven dedicated his Violin Concerto to his colleague Franz Clement, a prominent violinist of the time. The first of the piece was presented in Vienna in 1806. The piece was only interpreted a handful of times during the following decades. However, the work took a new lease of life in 1844, when the young violinist Joseph Joachim, barely 12 years old, performed with the London Philharmonic Society, under the direction of Mendelssohn. Since then, Beethoven's Violin Concerto has been one of the most important concertos in the classical repertoire. This work, renowned for its wide range of cadenzas, poses a great technical and intellectual challenge, brilliantly picked up by Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021. Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: In Tales of Two Cities, the Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra celebrates the music and culture in eighteenth century coffee houses of Leipzig and Damascus with works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and classical Arabic music. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century. The cities of Leipzig and Damascus both lay at the crossroads of ancient trading routes and are important centres of scholarship and famous for their coffee houses, where music was performed by the most brilliant musicians of the day. This concert presents works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and treasures of classical Arabic music. In this cross-cultural café, music, words, and images are used to explore the ways in which people separated by great distances are bound together by trade, ideas, and art. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto. Created by Alison Mackay and staging by Marshall Pynkoski.

programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and shō, a Japanese free-reed mouth organ, played here by Naomi Sato. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy. programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this festival theme, of this two-part documentary offers a peek into the inner-city churches of Utrecht. From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht. Episode 1 offers a peek into the inner city churches of Utrecht, visiting the source of inspiration if this year's festival: the English estate Boughton House, where the Duke of Buccleuch shows us around.

This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. programme.title: La Moresca - Addio, Daedalus
programme.desc: After more than thirty years at the top Ensemble Daedalus is saying goodbye to the concert stage. That demands a fitting farewell. Roberto Festa sought and found music that mirrors his journey over three decades. With Italian carnival songs and morescas by Renaissance composers such as Barbetta, Banchieri, and Falconieri, this farewell will be above all a party, with - true to tradition - first-rate performers, such as his traveling companion Marco Beasley. programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: The Unanswered Ives (2018) is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). The documentary sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question who was Charles Ives?" The Unanswered Ives is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14. Following his graduation from the music department at Yale University, the young composer decided to pursue a career outside of the arts. He started working in insurance, co-founding an innovative and highly successful insurance company. It was in his spare time that Ives composed his ambitious music, in which he experimented with advanced features including polytonality, twelve-tone technique, and quarter tones. The documentary film The Unanswered Ives (2018) sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question who was Charles Ives?"

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Holst worked on his orchestral suite The Planets, as an expression of his interest in astrology, from 1914 to 1916. The Planets consists of seven movements, each one named after the planet known at that time (excluding Earth), and its corresponding astrological character: Mars: the Bringer of War, Venus: the Bringer of Peace, Mercury: the Winged Messenger, Jupiter: the Bringer of Jollity, Saturn: the Bringer of Old Age, Uranus: the Magician, and Neptune: the Mystic. The middle section of Jupiter features a glorious melody that has become widely known. Holst adapted this melody when he set the poem I Vow to thee to thy Country to music. The last movement of The Planets includes a women’s choir, lending the music its mysterious, celestial atmosphere.

programme.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
programme.desc: Davidsbündlertänze (Dances of the League of David), Op. 6, is a group of eighteen pieces for piano composed in 1837, named after Schumann's fictional music society Davidsbündler. In these, the active and the passive aspects of Schumann’s personality, represented by the characters Florestan and Eusebius, engage in musical dialogues about contemporary music. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049. This concerto features solos from two recorders and a violin. The recorders play a prominent role in the concerto’s second movement, while the violin dominates the fast first and third movements.

programme.title: Fischer conducts Prokofiev and Stravinsky
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2. Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Wagner - Parsifal
programme.desc: From the stage of the German Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, the Deutsches Symphonie-Orchester Berlin presents Nikolas Lehnhoff's splendid interpretation of Parsifal under the baton of Kent Nagano, recorded in 2004. Among the soloists are Thomas Hampson (Amfortas), Bjarni Thor Kristinsson (Titurel), and Matti Salminen (Gurnemaz). After its 1882 premiere at the second Bayreuth Festival, Wagner's Parsifal was not interpreted elsewhere for three decades. Since the Metropolitan Opera in New York took on the epic tale on the quest for the holy grail, the work has steadily increased in popularity and been interpreted all over the world. However, few interpretations of Richard Wagner's Parsifal received as much critical acclaim as did Nikolas Lehnhoff's version for the English National Opera in 1999. Critics at The Guardian described the production as "one of the best interpretations [they] had ever seen." Lehnhoff, who was once an assistant to Wieland Wagner, opera director and grandson of the legendary composer, gives new life to the epic tale without forceful renovation - simply by shining a light on often neglected supporting characters. From the stage of the German Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, the Deutsches Symphonie-Orchester Berlin presents Lehnhoff's splendid interpretation of Parsifal under the baton of Kent Nagano, recorded in 2004. Among the soloists are Thomas Hampson (Amfortas), Bjarni Thor Kristinsson (Titurel), Matti Salminen (Gurnemaz), Christopher Ventris (Parsifal), Tom Fox (Klingsor), and Waltraud Meier (Kundry).

Since the Metropolitan Opera in New York took on the epic tale on the quest for the holy grail, the work has steadily increased in popularity and been interpreted all over the world. However, few interpretations of Richard Wagner's Parsifal received as much critical acclaim as did Nikolas Lehnhoff's version for the English National Opera in 1999. Critics at The Guardian described the production as "one of the best interpretations [they] had ever seen." Lehnhoff, who was once an assistant to Wieland Wagner, opera director and grandson of the legendary composer, gives new life to the epic tale without forceful renovation - simply by shining a light on often neglected supporting characters. From the stage of the German Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, the Deutsches Symphonie-Orchester Berlin presents Lehnhoff's splendid interpretation of Parsifal under the baton of Kent Nagano, recorded in 2004. Among the soloists are Thomas Hampson (Amfortas), Bjarni Thor Kristinsson (Titurel), Matti Salminen (Gurnemaz), Christopher Ventris (Parsifal), Tom Fox (Klingsor), and Waltraud Meier (Kundry).

programme.title: The Red Priest and the Tanguero
programme.desc: The set YES Camerata (Young European String Camerata) and the violinist William Hagen interpret The four seasons of Antonio Vivaldi and Las quatros estaciones porteñas of Astór Piazzolla to the Academiezaal of the Belgian city of Saint-Trond, in 2017. The ensemble YES Camerata (Young European String Camerata) and violinist William Hagen perform The Red Priest and the Tanguero at the Academiezaal in the Belgian city of Sint-Truiden in 2017. The concert program includes The Four Seasons of Antonio Vivaldi (1679-1741) and Las quatros estaciones porteñas of Astór Piazzolla (1921-1992), in a transcription of Leonid Desyatnikov. YES Camerata is a young dynamic string ensemble that performs without a conductor. The young American violinist William Hagen was the third winner of the prestigious Queen Elisabeth competition in 2015.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony in Three Movements
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic and Vadim Repin during the Europakonzert of 2008 from the Tchaikovsky Conservatory. On the program are Stravinsky’s Symphony in Three Movements. Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance. The orchestra opens with an outstanding performance of Stravinsky’s Symphony in Three Movements.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita
programme.desc: Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece’s duration is longer than the composer’s other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Bizet - Carmen
programme.desc: The wild-romantic Roman quarry of St. Margarethen provided the perfect backdrop for this live recording of Bizet's Carmen. This exciting production brought horses, pyrotechnical special effects and more than 400 participants onto the stage. The wild and breathtaking scenery of Austria's Roman Quarry of St. Margarethen provides an ideal and unique backdrop for this live and colourful open-air performance of Georges Bizet's opera Carmen (1875). With over 400 participants, this opulent staging of Bizet's famous opera - one of the most popular works in the genre's history - proves a feast for all the senses. Austria's Opera Festival St. Margarethen, one of Europe's most important open-air festivals, is attended by about 220, 000 opera lovers every year. The Brno National Theatre Orchestra & Chorus is led by conductor Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists are Nadia Krasteva, Russi Nikov and Alexandr Antonenko.

Svaki dan uče nešto novo - slova, brojeve, boje, životinje i još mnogo toga. A sve to kroz igru i pjesmice koje lako ulaze u uho!

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

Svaki dan uče nešto novo - slova, brojeve, boje, životinje i još mnogo toga. A sve to kroz igru i pjesmice koje lako ulaze u uho!

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Moto Fighters
programme.desc: Stigli su nezaustavljivi, snažniji i brži Moto Fightersi! Moto Fighters borbe trenutno su najpopularniji natjecateljski događaj. programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. programme.title: Prvi Nacionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: Centralna informativna emisija televizije Pink predstavlja spoj iskusnih urednika sa tradicijom, i mladih novinara koji prate duh vremena. Tim koji pobeđuje svakodnevno, 365 dana u godini kreira program, koji je prema agenciji Nielsen, najgledaniji centralno informativni program svih komercijalnih emitera u Srbiji.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. Osim novog studija i dobro poznatih rubrika - "Pričalo se o...", "Dogodilo se", "Premotavanje", "Sa lica mesta", "Beograd noću", "Dan za nama", "Njihovih 1800 sekundi sa Nemanjom", "Nedeljno popodne sa..." i "Muzički kutak" - sedma sezona "Premijera - Vikend specijala" doneće i potpuno nove rubrike u svakoj emisiji.

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Hit tvit
programme.desc: "Hit Tvit" je prema merenjima agencije "Nilsen" najgledaniji politički talk show u Srbiji, a od ostalih sličnih formata izdvaja ga interaktivnost televizije i korisnika društvenih mreža. Tvitovanjem i objavljivanjem statusa na Fejsbuku, korisnici imaju mogućnost da sa voditeljkom Vericom Bradić biraju priloge koji se emituju u emisiji. Upravo o tim prilozima, koji se uvek tiču aktuelnih političkih događaja iz zemlje i sveta, sa Vericom će u studiju diskutovati stručni gosti različitih političkih opredeljenja, što ovaj politički talk show čini dinamičnim.

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. POČINJE SPEKTAKL! ZVEZDE SE RAĐAJU!

programme.title: Prijevara, film
programme.desc: Razočarani deratizator i samohrani otac Freddie Manning (AL SHEARER) uvijek nastoji izmuljati nešto više iz svog razočaravajućeg života, ali prati ga loša sreća. programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: „Novo vikend jutro na Pinku u novoj televizijskoj sezoni vodi Jovana Jeremić. Svake subote i nedelje od 05:30 do 13:00 časova, Jovana će obrađivati sve aktuelne teme iz zemlje i sveta sa stručnim sagovornicima i napraviće retrospektivu svih najvažnijih događaja koji su obeležili prethodnu nedelju. U okviru "Novog vikend jutra", gledaoci će se upoznati sa novim rubrikama: "Press pretres" koji podrazumeva prelistavanje dnevne štampe uz osvrt na one teme o kojima se najviše pričalo; "Pravo metu" kroz koju će Jovana obrađivati temu jutra; "Verovali ili ne, i ovo postoji" je rubrika rezervisana za one teme i događaje koji su začudili i iznenadili javnost; u okviru rubrike "TV duel" Jovana će ugostiti dve suprotstavljene strane koje će imati priliku da iskažu svoje mišljenje o datoj temi; i "Vikend retrovizor" koji predstavlja rekapitulaciju svega što je obeležilo prethodnu nedelju.

programme.title: Prvi Nacionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: Centralna informativna emisija televizije Pink predstavlja spoj iskusnih urednika sa tradicijom, i mladih novinara koji prate duh vremena. Tim koji pobeđuje svakodnevno, 365 dana u godini kreira program, koji je prema agenciji Nielsen, najgledaniji centralno informativni program svih komercijalnih emitera u Srbiji.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: Vikend specijal
programme.desc: I u novoj televizijskoj sezoni, nedeljno popodne biće rezervisano za najaktuelnije ličnosti iz javnog života Srbije i ekskluzivne priče o poznatima, a očekuju vas i nove rubrike. Kao što ste navikli, očekuju vas najaktuenije priče o poznatima koje su obeležile protekli period.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. Osim novog studija i dobro poznatih rubrika - "Pričalo se o...", "Dogodilo se", "Premotavanje", "Sa lica mesta", "Beograd noću", "Dan za nama", "Njihovih 1800 sekundi sa Nemanjom", "Nedeljno popodne sa..." i "Muzički kutak" - sedma sezona "Premijera - Vikend specijala" doneće i potpuno nove rubrike u svakoj emisiji.

programme.title: Kafanica blizu SIS-a, serija
programme.desc: Već znamo da je "Agencija za sve i svašta" vlasotinačko preduzeće koje rešava sve probleme svojih klijenata. Osnivač i vlasnik firme je Spiridon Don Karamarković, nekadašnji pripadnik Legije stranaca, ekspert za sva pitanja i najškrtiji gazda na svetu. Deda mu je rekao da svaki uspešan Srbin mora da ima kafanu i on je ove godine osnovao svoju. Poslove oko kafane poverio je misterioznoj Madam Žaklini koja je naše gore list, ali je ugostiteljsko znanje sticala u Parizu.

programme.title: Hit tvit
programme.desc: "Hit Tvit" je prema merenjima agencije "Nilsen" najgledaniji politički talk show u Srbiji, a od ostalih sličnih formata izdvaja ga interaktivnost televizije i korisnika društvenih mreža. Tvitovanjem i objavljivanjem statusa na Fejsbuku, korisnici imaju mogućnost da sa voditeljkom Vericom Bradić biraju priloge koji se emituju u emisiji. Upravo o tim prilozima, koji se uvek tiču aktuelnih političkih događaja iz zemlje i sveta, sa Vericom će u studiju diskutovati stručni gosti različitih političkih opredeljenja, što ovaj politički talk show čini dinamičnim.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut, 2017
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa, 2018 - - Vic Bay
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. Who will claim victory and take the overall series winnings in the season finale of the City Surf Series?

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Dubrovnik, Ston, Korčula, Orebić, NP Mljet Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: We’re just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans. -Luise Grossmann. Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. The founders of FiveOceans give ocean rubbish a new life, using plastic collected from the Indian Ocean, proving it is possible to close the cycle with ocean waste and high quality surf gear. In this stunning documentary, they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. With their background in engineering, the unrivalled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities as the two friends battle their way to achieve a much higher goal: reducing the plastic that ends up in the oceans they surf.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The Crikvenica Riviera is one of the most scenic parts of the Adriatic coast with a rich diversity of attractive beaches, green hinterland, a continental wooden area, a climate that provides perfect refreshment in the summer time and just the right amount of action-packed fun in the sun. Find out more in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. The islands of Cres and Lošinj are connected to the ancient legend of Jason and the Argonauts in their search for the golden fleece aboard the Argo. Stick around to find out the best spots in these islands!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: Kite Masters

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes, 1 - Part 2
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup, 2014
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes, 1 - Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode we will visit the old town and the palace of the grand master, before we refresh ourselves in the Kallithea Springs, and discover why Rhodes is considered as the sailing Mecca of the Dodecanese. We’ll take a trip to the beautiful Stegna beach to dive in the immaculate crystal blue waters, before venturing out on a SUP, a stand-up paddle board, to experience the unique and ever-growing practice of SUP Yoga. Finally, we’ll visit Panagia Tsambika, a hilltop monastery considered by some to be miracle-working.

programme.title: Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship, 2025 - GP of Italy (Puglia)
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Welcome, sailors! In this episode of Sail-ho Croatia we arrive to the incredibly beautiful, fragrant and action-packed island of Cres. The islands of Cres and Lošinj are connected to the ancient legend of Jason and the Argonauts in their search for the golden fleece aboard the Argo. Stick around to find out the best spots in these islands!

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes, 1 - Part 2
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup, 2014
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Tučepi, Baška Voda, Split, Supetar, Bol Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Sailing to the Games, 2024
programme.desc: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

programme.title: Sailing to the Games, 2024

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to the beautiful island of Symi, Greece, in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometres northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometres of mountainous terrain. In this series we will discover the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio as we learn more about the hospitable harbour of the island, a popular resting place for sailors to park up and explore. Symi is home to a long tradition of shipbuilding, handmade boats with real charm. Get to know first-hand this handiwork before visiting the historic castle and taking a ride on a traditional Grecian boat. You will see this apparently small island is filled with a vast variety of things to do, see and eat. Join us on Nautical Channel on our journey to the Aegean Sea to discover the secrets of Symi.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show, 2021
programme.desc: In this episode 9 of Maxiboat, we test an Italian RIB with the incredible Capelli Stradivari 43. Then, we take a look back at the 2021 edition of the Nautic (Paris Boat Show) and a selection of the sailing and motor boats that were not to be missed. Finally, we are back to traditional sailing and motor yachting with the most beautiful pictures of the Monaco Classic Week 2021 edition.

programme.title: Jump On Board, 2013: Greece
programme.desc: The Aegean Sea is a mythological setting where western culture started from. Along with our two sailors, Zita and Abi, Mia will be mooring in Skyathos, and the girls are already more aware of the journey that lies ahead of them. This will trully be an amazing journey to make them become true sailors. Are you joining us?

programme.title: Enklava, film
programme.desc: Ostvarenje koje je imalo svetsku premijeru na 43. FEST-u, pripoveda o srpskoj zajednici koja je ostala da živi na Kosovu u enklavama. Tema nije iz novina - rušenje groblja ili kamenovanje autobusa. To je samo okvir za suštinu Enklave - a to su identitet i opstanak Srba u Pokrajini. Film obrađuje temu srpske zajednice koja je ostala na Kosovu da živi u malim izolovanim zajednicama - enklavama. Primorani na ovakav život, ograničeni da žive na skučenom prostoru, Srbi koji su ostali da žive na Kosovu i Metohiji žive svoje živote na veoma težak način. Šta se dešava kad neko premine u enklavi, a groblje se nalazi van nje, na neprijateljskoj teritoriji? U ovoj priči, uz mnogo peripetija, jedan osamdesetogodišnji starac će, ipak, biti sahranjen zahvaljujući svom unuku, desetogodišnjem dečaku koji se usudio da učini nešto nemoguće za obe zajednice na Kosovu, i srpsku i albansku: da zavoli i stekne prijatelja na suprotnoj strani. Iskusnu glumačku postavu od Nebojše Glogovca, preko Anice Dobre do Miodraga Krivokapića, svojom iskrenošću nadograđuju dečaci naturščici Srba i Albanaca s Kosova i Metohije, koji dočaravaju male, a već velike ljude čije su sudbine odraz sveopšte drame.

programme.title: Đavolja varoš, film
programme.desc: Film o ljudima koje vode osnovne ljudske potrebe - instinkti, opsesije, ambicije, strahovi i frustracije. Skup različitih likova čiji se putevi isprepliću u jednom danu...

programme.title: Beogradski fantom, film
programme.desc: „Beogradski fantom snimljen je po istinitom događaju iz 1979. Te godine, u Beogradu, mladić po imenu Vlada Vasiljević ukrao je bijeli „Porsche 911 S Targa" i deset noći uzastopno izluđivao policiju noćnim vožnjama. Bezuspješni pokušaji pripadnika policije da bijeli „Porsche" zaustave „Zastavama" 1300 i 101 okupljali su na Slaviji svake noći sve brojniju publiku, čije simpatije su nepodjeljeno bile na strani beogradskog fantoma, kako je narod prozvao misterioznog vozača. U to vrijeme „beogradski fantom postao je svojevrsni simbol otpora jugoslavenskom sistemu i zbog toga je stekao veliku popularnost među građanima. Vlada Vasiljević, kad su ga uhvatili, odležao je u zatvoru dvije godine, a kasnije je smrtno stradao u prometnoj nesreći pod nerazjašnjenim okolnostima. Film je snimljen 30 godina nakon stvarnih događaja, a među njegove najveće kvalitete svakako spada uravnoteženost dokumentarnih i igranih djelova, kompjuterski efekti kojima je rekonstruiran nekadašnji izgled trga Slavija, uzbudljive scene automobilskih potjera te efektna glazba. Riječ je o diplomskom filmu redatelja Jovana Todorovića.

programme.title: Boj na Kosovu, film
programme.desc: Srpski knez Lazar 1389. godine odbija da se pokori turskom sultanu Muratu koji sa velikom vojskom nadire prema Srbiji da bi preko nje nastavio osvajanje Evrope. Iako svestan da je slabiji, bez dovoljno i dobro opremljene vojske, knez Lazar odlučuje da mu se suprotstavi. Srpski velikaši su nejedinstveni. Većina je za borbu makar i po cenu poraza ali se neki kolebaju. Sve što je za oružje sposobno upućuje se ka polju Kosovu. Bitka na Kosovu, 1389. godine završena je bez pobednika - obe su vojske iskrvarile i posustale. Ginu i Lazar i Murat. Ali ipak, boj na Kosovu je dobijen - ne za srpsku državu koja je uskoro pala u turske ruke - već za Evropu, koju je telima svojih junaka spasila od prvog i najjačeg naleta turske najezde.

programme.title: Poslednja trka, film
programme.desc: Dvanaestogodišnji dječak razvedenih roditelja živi u naselju solitera, ali sivilo njegovog urbanog življenja razbija blizina hipodroma i ergela. Dječakov ljubimac je nekadašnji šampion, konj Zimzelen, kojeg je, nažalost, uprava ergele odlučila prodati klanici. Poslije uzaludnog pokušaja da upravu odvrate od odluke, djeca ukradu konja i nestanu. Shvativši najzad što djeci znači ovaj konj, poklone ga dječakovom razredu.

programme.title: Turneja, film
programme.desc: 1993. šestero beogradskih glumaca pritisnuti lošom financijskom situacijom, nesvjesni ozbiljnosti ratnog stanja, pristaju otputovati u Srpsku krajinu kako bi tamo u mjestu Srbobran izveli Feydeauevu predstavu "Buba u uhu". Putuju u transporteru i ubrzo doživljavaju prvo bombardiranje. U Srbobranu ih dočekuje pukovnik Gavro, te saznaju da će imati dvije predstave: jednu u mjestu za civile, a drugu na prvoj liniji za vojnike... Turneja (2008) je antiratni film poznatog srpskog redatelja Gorana Markovića (Specijalno vaspitanje, Nacionalna klasa, Variola vera, Tito i ja) koji vrlo jasno progovara o ratu u Bosni. Sam čin putovanja glumaca u starom transporteru podsjeća na Šijanov "Tko to tamo peva" samo što u "Turneji" protagonisti putuju iz Beograda. Pun komičnih i apsurdnih situacija, film kritizira velikosrpsku politiku i ismijava nacionalizam. Turneja je dobila nagradu međunarodnog žirija kritike FIPRESCI za najbolje ostvarenje na filmskom festivalu u Montrealu, a Goran Marković nagradu za najbolju režiju. Jednu od glavnih uloga u filmu tumači izvrsna Mira Furlan. U koprodukciji ovog filma su sudjelovale: Bosna i Hercegovina, Hrvatska i Slovenija.

programme.title: Žikina ženidba, film
programme.desc: U posljednjem dijelu čuvene sage o doživljajima dvojice prijatelja, Milan je odlučio pomoći Žiki i unijet malo promjena u njegov život. Odlučio ga je oženiti! Da bi došli do odgovarajuće kandidatkinje stavili su oglas u svim domaćim, ali i stranim novinama. Od Slovenije pa sve do Brazila, ponude na VHS kazetama neprestano stižu, a kako Žika ne bi pogriješio u izboru, Milan nesebično pomaže u eliminiranju bračnih ponuda.

programme.title: Nacionalna klasa, film
programme.desc: Humoristična drama o samoživom automobilistu koji se i pored neukrotive osobne prirode nađe zatočen u egzistencijalnom beznađu. Branimir Brane Mitrović zvani Floyd 27-godišnji je beogradski automobilist koji se uoči odlučujuće trke nalazi na trećem mjestu u ukupnom poretku u tzv. nacionalnoj klasi do 785 kubika, tj. u konkurenciji zastava 750, popularnih fića. Floyd je samoživ i neodgovoran zgubidan kojeg otac mesar stalno kritizira a majka tetoši, i koji uporno izbjegava poziv za služenje vojnog roka, tek formalno upisujući svake godine novi fakultet. Tako se sad odlučio na studij glume, gdje uoči prijemnog ispita upoznaje privlačnu Senku koju smjesta poželi, nimalo se ne obazirući na osjećaje svoje poluslužbene djevojke Vukosave zvane Šiljo. Međutim, Šiljo mu priopći da je ostala u drugom stanju, a njezini imućni roditelji, u dogovoru s Floydovim, ne pitajući ništa o tome Floyda i Šilju, pripreme svadbu... Nacionalna klasa do 785 ccm drugi je cjelovečernji igrani film Gorana Markovića, istaknutog pripadnika beogradskog ogranka tzv. praške škole kinematografije socijalističke Jugoslavije. Marković je debitirao dvije godine ranije Specijalnim vaspitanjem koje je smjesta steklo kultni status, dok je Nacionalna klasa bila manje kritički uvažena, ali prihvaćena od publike i rado gledana. Njezin središnji lik tipični je predstavnik karakterizacijskih stremljenja praške škole u tematiziranju suvremene urbane omladine (pa i šire): izdvojeni individualac koji se ne uklapa u društveno okruženje, međutim nepovratno je u njemu zarobljen što mu egzistenciju čini, bez obzira na njezinu eventualnu dinamičnost (kao u ovom slučaju), dubinski sumornom. Dragan Nikolić odličan je u ulozi u kakvima je nerijetko nastupao tijekom svoje karijere, dakle onoj anarhoidnog mladog čovjeka kao više ili manje dalekog izdanka Godardova Michela Poiccarda iz slavnog filma Do posljednjeg daha (tumačio ga je Jean-Paul Belmondo), s tim da ovdje njegov lik - za razliku od Godardova - ne skončava (apsurdistički intoniranom) nasilnom smrću kojom zapravo zadržava svoju slobodu, nego biva zarobljen nametnutim mu okovima malograđanskih životnih nazora. Sličan lik, lik Džimija Barke, tumačio je Nikolić i u klasiku Živojina Pavlovića Kad budem mrtav i beo, a Živojin Pavlović u Nacionalnoj klasi pojavljuje se u maloj cameo-roli. Spomenimo da naslovnu pjesmu filma pjeva Dado Topić, a da se među izvođačima pjesama uvrštenih u film nalaze i Oliver Dragojević, Slađana Milošević, Oliver Mandić i braća Vranešević.

programme.title: Ko to tamo peva, film
programme.desc: Crna komedija o skupini putnika koji autobusom kreću prema Beogradu 24 sata uoči napada Trećeg Reicha na Jugoslaviju. Negdje u Srbiji, 5. travnja 1941. Skupina putnika iščekuje autobus tvrtke "Krstić i sin" kako bi što prije stigla u Beograd, udaljen stotinjak kilometara. Među njima su i postariji seljak Aleksa (Milivoje Tomić), čiji je sin u vojsci, njegov boležljivi suputnik koji smatra da su mu dani odbrojani (Borislav Stjepanović), dotjerani pjevač koji se brine za svoj glas (Dragan Nikolić), zatim Brka, pristalica reda i zakona (Danilo Stojković), jedan zbunjeni lovac (Taško Načić), braća ulični svirači (Miodrag i Nenad Kostić), te upravo vjenčani bračni par (Neda Arnerić i Slavko Štimac). Kada rasklimani crveni autobus vlasnika Krstića (Pavle Vujisić) i njegova lakovjernog sina Miška (Aleksandar Berček) napokon ukrca putnike, započet će putovanje prepuno problema i međusobnih nesuglasica koje će se odužiti na cijeli dan i noć...Jedno od najuspješnijih razdoblja srbijanske kinematografije, tada još uvijek unutar Jugoslavije, svakako je početak 1980-ih. Riječ je o godinama stvaralaštva redatelja Slobodana Šijana čiji se filmovi Ko to tamo peva i Maratonci trče počasni krug s pravom smatraju remek-djelima crne komedije. Tako je ratna tragikomedija Ko to tamo peva iz 1980. briljantno ocrtala propast jugoslavenske kraljevine uoči početka Drugog svjetskog rata usredotočujući se na metaforično putovanje skupine putnika iz srbijanske provincije u Beograd. Šijanov je film uprizorenje reskog i duhovitog teksta njegova dugogodišnjeg suradnika, scenarista i dramatičara Dušana Kovačevića. Kovačević je kroz niz sjajno profiliranih likova i njihovih urnebesnih dogodovština na putu, veoma autentično i veoma zabavno opisao svu gorčinu i grotesku sredine koja ni na koji način nije korespondirala s povijesno prijelomnim vremenom. Upravo je ta dihotomija tzv. malih ljudi i velikih događaja bravurozno eruptirala u Šijanovom filmu koji svoj uspjeh duguje kako pristupom najširoj publici, tako i kontekstualiziranjem događaja što je filmu donijelo niz domaćih i međunarodnih priznanja. Mnogi su kritičari Šijanov dotrajali crveni autobus iz filma usporedili sa samom Jugoslavijom, a katarzičnu završnicu pod bombama Trećeg Reicha s njezinim nezaustavljivim slomom. Uostalom, film spaja nekoliko važnih godina: govori od 1941.-oj kada je u Jugoslaviji počeo Drugi svjetski rat, snimljen je 1980. kada je preminuo njezin predsjednik i ratni vođa Josip Broz Tito, a u njemu je, s vremenskom distancom, moguće prepoznati štošta od definitivnog raspada Jugoslavije 1991. Izvrsnu glumačku ekipu čine pokojni Pavle Vujisić, doajen srbijanskog glumišta, u ulozi vlasnika autobusa i konduktera, zatim Aleksandar Berček kao njegov sin, te Dragan Nikolić kao pjevač, a uz popularne glumce Boru Todorovića, Danila Stojkovića, Slavka Štimca, Taška Načića i Nedu Arnerić, svakako treba istaknuti i pjevačko-svirački dvojac, braću Miodraga i Nenada Kostića. Njihovi su uglazbljeni komentari i središnja pjesma jednako proslavili film kao i njegov zaplet i humor. Glazbu je skladao Vojislav Kostić, dok je efektna fotografija pustare u kojoj se odvija predapokaliptična radnja djelo snimatelja Božidara Nikolića. Ko to tamo peva postao je pravi kinohit diljem bivše SFRJ dospjevši na prva mjesta najgledanijih filmova u 1980.-oj, a uz pulsku Zlatnu arenu za ulogu Aleksandra Berčeka i Zlatni vijenac tjednika Studio, Šijanov je uradak dobio nekoliko uglednih međunarodnih filmskih nagrada među kojima i nagradu na festivalu u Montrealu, te Grand Prix na festivalu u Rotterdamu.

programme.title: Zona mrtvih, film
programme.desc: U cijeloj Srbiji se odvijaju velike vojne vježbe, i Pančevo postaje grad pod opsadom. Na željezničkoj stanici ovog industrijskog grada, nesretnim stjecajem okolnosti, dolazi do ispuštanja eksperimentalnog i vrlo opasnog biokemijskog otrova. Iako mu je namjena nepoznata, izgleda da otrov zaražene ljude pretvara u zombije željne krvi. U isto vrijeme, agenti Interpola u suradnji sa našim snagama, provode transport zatvorenika iz Vršca za Beograd. U transportu je samo jedan jedini zatvorenik, misteriozne prošlosti, i naizgled vrlo opasan. Na drugom kraju grada, ambiciozni, strani novinar, sa grupom lokalnih prijatelja, kreće do željezničke stanice, gdje je otrovni plin i pušten, kako bi o tome napravio ekskluzivnu reportažu. Ubrzo nailaze na prve zaražene stanovnike, i shvaćaju da je bijeg iz grada jedini izlaz. Srpski horor "Zona Mrtvih" nominiran je u kategoriji za najbolji horor na festivalu Fantasy Horror Award koji se u organizaciji Fantasy Channell i Fun Factory Entertainment održava od 19. do 21. ožujka u talijanskom gradu Orvietu

jazzahead! 2023, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead! paid special attention to Germany’s jazz scene and invited thirty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the artists presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2023 is Canadian singer and bandleader Dominique Fils-Aimé. Her ethereal yet powerful vocals are paired with a tight-knit band to deliver a fresh take on jazz and blues with hints of R&B and free improvisation. Her single Feeling Like a Plant serves as a sign of great things to come.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programs: BIRD.tv, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first-row seat! Discover an irresistible live act; STUFF is full of unflagging energy. The Belgian band was founded in 2012 when drummer Lander Gyselinck was asked to play live music between DJ sets at a local bar. He gathered a bunch of friends, who also were musicians. The band could be considered an avant-garde jazz band who play a mix of funk, hip-hop, and electro. Andrew Claes (saxophone), Dries Laheye (bass guitar), Lander Gyselinck (drums), Mixmonster Menno (samples), and Joris Caluwaerts (keyboards) share an exceptional connection in music. They take over every stage and melt the hearts of music lovers.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin’, Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Seven Eleven: Back to the Source, Jazz
programme.desc: Dutch band Seven Eleven is a mix of funk, jazz and hip hop. Founded in 1987, Seven Eleven is one of the first Dutch bands to perform with rappers, having collaborated with hip hop crew Dope Posse in 1990. Adding a superb horn section to the original line-up, they were awarded the 1993 Camelpop Award. Over the years, Seven Eleven released eight albums and played countless festivals, including three appearances at the prestigious North Sea Jazz Festival. Collaborations with legendary American funk artists such as Fred Wesley, Dawn Silva, Jeanette Washington and Louis Johnson followed. Guitarist Rob Manzoli of pop group Right Said Fred produced Seven Eleven’s 2015 album Back to the Source in London. Today’s broadcast presents the funkiest moments from Seven Eleven’s Back to the Source tour.

programme.title: The Blue Necklace, Concert
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Terrasson & Belmondo: À Nous Garo, Modern
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française. The Franco-American pianist Terrasson delights in travelling the world, collaboration with others and leading his own trio, quartet, or quintet. With his long-time friend, Stéphane Belmondo, Terrasson has produced wonderful CDs and beautiful concerts. One then finds the trumpeter on the pianist’s album ‘Gouache’; on another, the pianist guests on Belmondo’s ‘Ever After’. At the Jazz en Baie festival, the duo plays its amazing piano and trumpet music. Highly recommended!
